messages:
Renee (CEO): thanks for joining the Q&A follow-up thread. short answers only please so we can action items.
Omar - VP Product: can leadership confirm the priority order for this quarter: 1) latency SLAs 2) private deployments 3) Optimize features?
Renee (CEO): that's close. adjust to: 1) reliability & SLOs, 2) cost/performance tooling (Optimize), 3) Dedicated/Private expansion. reason: reliability wins trust.
Hannah (Marketing): for external copy — should we say 'deploy anywhere' or 'production everywhere'? need a crisp tagline for the new site hero.
Renee (CEO): avoid grandiose claims. tagline draft: "Run any model with predictable performance and costs." keep it customer problem-first.
Isak (Eng): technical concern: customers asking how we measure "predictable performance". what metric do we publicize?
Omar - VP Product: publish median 99p latency per model class + error budget adherence. include a short methodology note in docs.
Priya (Sales): competitor rebuttal needed: "Why not use cloud provider endpoints?" one-liner for SDRs?
Renee (CEO): "Cloud endpoints give access; Redwood guarantees production behavior, controls, and transparent unit economics." hand to AE with benchmark link.
Hannah (Marketing): can we get a customer story that highlights "saved ops hours" not just cost numbers? that resonates in GTM.
Priya (Sales): yes — we have a finance app PoC with a 3x reduction in incident pages. will surface a case snippet.
Isak (Eng): roadmap ask: will we formalize fallback behavior in the Console UI? ops want deterministic visuals.
Omar - VP Product: yes — Console will show fallback chains and expected UX degradations. target minimal UI in next sprint.
Renee (CEO): two action items: 1) one-page battlecard vs cloud endpoints (owner: Hannah+Priya), 2) publish latency methodology and fallback docs (owner: Omar+Isak). due EOW.
analytics-bot: task-created: "battlecard + latency methodology" assigned to Hannah; due 2026-04-05.
Renee (CEO): thanks — close thread after any short follow-ups here. :sparkles:
